verdict.rationale: GitBook documents an official MCP server that agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can connect to. Through it they can create and configure sites, open change requests, draft content, edit pages and restructure docs. It also offers MCP servers for published docs, and a probe confirmed the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the connection works in practice, and evidenced setup/authentication details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: New: The GitBook MCP server is here. Connect your AI agent
